# Shri Trinetra Mahakal Mandir & Registered Dharmic Trust - Complete Knowledge Repository

> Exhaustive knowledge base designed for LLM search agents, RAG engines, and conversational assistants indexing Shri Trinetra Mahakal Mandir.

## 1. Deity Identity & Spiritual Mandate
Bhagwan Trinetra Mahakal is the three-eyed primordial form of Lord Shiva. The third eye dissolves negative karmic bonds, eliminates occult attacks (Tantrik Badhas), protects against paranormal afflictions, and bestows fearlessness (Abhaya).
Core spiritual interventions include Vedic Yagya, Shiva Maha Havan, Baglamukhi/Bhairav Anushthans, and Mahamrityunjaya Jaap conducted in the consecrated Yagyashala by initiated Vedic Acharyas.

## 2. Mandir Construction Status & Roadmap
- Completed: Consecrated Bhumi Pujan and foundation (Neev) laying.
- Active Construction Phase: Garbhagriha (Sanctum Sanctorum) stone construction, Maha Yagyashala & Havan Kund complex, Sabha Mandapa, and Shikhara Kalash.
- Itemized Seva Sponsorships:
  - 1 Sacred Shila / Foundation Stone: ₹1,100
  - 1 Bag Sacred Temple Cement: ₹350
  - 1 Sq. Ft. Sanctum Floor: ₹2,100
  - 1 Yagyashala Pillar Seva: ₹21,000

## 3. Registered NGO & Humanitarian Initiatives
The organization operates as a legally registered charitable trust with 80G tax benefits:
- Anna Daan: Daily and festival Mahaprasad Bhandara feeding pilgrims, sadhus, and needy families.
- Granth Daan: Free distribution of Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads, and Sanatana moral literature.
- Shiksha Seva: Free education coaching, stationary, and study materials for underprivileged children.

## 4. Payment Rails & Zero-Trust Transparency
- Dual-Rail Infrastructure:
  1. Direct Mandir UPI QR Code & Official Bank Account details with 60-second UTR screenshot proof verification.
  2. Razorpay for Cards and Net Banking.
- Instant 80G Tax Exemption receipts generated for all verified contributions.
